sections.Profile:
The Student Prince , released by Williams in 1968, is a four-player electro-mechanical pinball machine themed around the operetta "The Student Prince," featuring art by Christian Marche and design by Steve Kordek.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1968
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: School, German, Pointy People, Zipper Flippers, Beer, Theater, Music, Single level playfield
